name: Elgato Key Light
author: nille
description: Elgato Key Light control: power, brightness, and color temperature for one or many lights.

barWidget.description: Toggle Elgato Key Lights, set brightness and color temperature, as a group or per light.

schema.label: Light addresses
schema.description: Optional. Comma-separated IP addresses (e.g. 192.168.1.10, 192.168.1.11) to skip mDNS discovery. Leave empty to find lights automatically.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read light state while the panel is open.

schema.label: Start in group mode
schema.description: Control all lights together by default. Toggle per-session with 'g' in the panel.

schema.label: Hide when no lights found
schema.description: Remove the bar icon entirely when no Key Lights are on the network.
